say:6:1310118001:0.text: Phew! After climbing a mountain in a snowstorm, getting attacked by wolves, dealing with an avalanche, and then that hornleaf bear... Chippy's exhausted!
say:6:1310118001:0.source_cn: 呼……在大雪天里爬山，又是狼，又是雪崩，又是叶角熊……...

say:7:1310118002:0.text: You must be utterly spent. How about I prepare something to eat? I have meat, vegetables, and ember mugwort—a warming herb. I'll brew a pot of hot soup with some fresh bread. How does that sound?
say:7:1310118002:0.source_cn: 你们一定很累了，想要吃点东西吗？肉、蔬菜，加上火绒蒿—...

say:8:1310118003:0.text: It sounds absolutely delectable! Faramor, you sure know your herbs, huh?
say:8:1310118003:0.source_cn: 太棒了，听起来好香！法拉莫尔先生，你似乎对草药很有研究？

say:9:1310118004:1.text: Oh, I wouldn't go so far as to call myself an expert—merely well-versed in the fundamentals. Now, allow me to prepare something. I can already hear your familiar's stomach growling from here.
say:9:1310118004:1.source_cn: 谈不上“很有研究”，只是对常用的草药比较熟悉而已。我还...

say:10:1310118005:0.text: Uh... well... don't laugh! It's been a rough day, and Chippy's starving! Faramor, once the soup's done, Chippy's having a whole bowl!
say:10:1310118005:0.source_cn: 哎呀……这个……不准笑！今天真的很累很饿！法拉莫尔先生...

narration:11:1310118006:0.text: You sit around the fire eating the warm soup and feel the day's exhaustion melt away...
narration:11:1310118006:0.source_cn: 汤煮好了，你们围坐在火炉边吃了热乎乎的炖汤，感觉一整天...

say:16:1310118007:0.text: It is quite cold this evening... I ought to bring some soup to those travelers as well.
say:16:1310118007:0.source_cn: 今晚很冷，我应该给那几位旅人也送些炖汤……

say:25:1310118009:0.text: Someone's screaming! It sounds like it's coming from that cabin!
say:25:1310118009:0.source_cn: 有人在尖叫！好像是从那个小屋传来的！

say:26:1310118010:0.text: Oh no! Someone must have left the cabin...
say:26:1310118010:0.source_cn: 糟糕！那几位旅人恐怕出事了，他们一定有人离开屋子了……

say:29:1310118013:0.text: No! Remain here. Do whatever you wish, but do not venture outside.
say:29:1310118013:0.source_cn: 不行！你们呆在这里，随便做什么都可以，但绝不要出门。

say:30:1310118014:0.text: Our magister's super strong, and we're tough too. We can handle the undead!
say:30:1310118014:0.source_cn: 我的主人很强的，我们也很厉害，不怕那些“活死人”。
say:30:1310118014:0.male: Our magister's super strong, and we're tough too. We can handle the undead!
say:30:1310118014:0.female: Our magister's super strong, and we're tough too. We can handle the undead!

say:31:1310118015:0.text: I have heard that many times, but few survive after saying it.
say:31:1310118015:0.source_cn: 这话我听过太多次了，但说过这句话以后还能活下来的是少数。

say:33:1310118017:0.text: <style="highlight">Fire is red.</style> If it is not, then something is amiss. Don't act rashly.

say:34:1310118018:1.text: There is no time to squander. Remain here until I return.
say:34:1310118018:1.source_cn: 不能再耽误时间了，你们在这里等我回来！

say:37:1310118019:0.text: Wait! What do you mean by—
say:37:1310118019:0.source_cn: 等等，法拉莫尔先生！你说的话是什么意思——？！

say:40:1310118021:0.text: The wind outside is picking up. We should stay inside for now.
say:40:1310118021:0.source_cn: 窗外的风声也更大了，我们还是先在屋里等等吧。

say:41:1310118022:0.text: Maybe we can pass the time by looking at Faramor's collection, or reading some books.
say:41:1310118022:0.source_cn: 可以欣赏一下法拉莫尔先生的收藏品，或者看看书来打发时间！

narration:43:13101017:0.text: As night falls, you gather around the fireplace to keep warm. You are about to doze off when you hear a piercing scream from outside.
narration:43:13101017:0.source_cn: 入夜后，你们聚在围炉四周取暖，昏昏入睡之时，忽然听到屋...

narration:44:13101017:0.text: As night falls, you gather around the fireplace to keep warm. You are about to doze off when you hear a piercing scream from outside.
narration:44:13101017:0.source_cn: 入夜后，你们聚在围炉四周取暖，昏昏入睡之时，忽然听到屋...
